items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I felt as if he was a friend. I always felt pretty good about Leonard.

ctx.x: Maybe . . . I know “Muskrat Ramble” was one. I’ve got the record upstairs. It’s really a collector’s item. The idea was good, but I guess Leonard always had these . . . like Cats vs. Chicks. That was another one that he had. All these crazy things. I don’t know. I lost track there.
O.k., so at this point what we’ve done . . . so that was . . . you were in Chicago a total of about three months, or was it longer?
